{{Box|title=The unseen, and the riddle|content=
Aurefold is a world of '''mystic realism''': magic — if it exists — is nearly invisible and always ambiguous. Was it magic, chance, or myth? The sources never decide, and neither does this wiki.

* [[The eleventh house]] — the miscount that survived four hundred years
